WLC public domain; imported OSHB morphology CC BY4.0 is fallible. No earliest manuscript certification. Return JSON {verses:[{id,translations:{ko,en,es},basis,reason_ko,counterargument_ko,current_opinion_ko,reconsider_if_ko,final_opinion_ko}],final_opinion_ko}. Discuss v16 infinitive absolute, pain/pregnancy two nouns versus hendiadys, desire toward husband (do not presume against/control/sexual-only), rule descriptive versus imperative. V17 Adam name, cursed ground because of you, painful toil and quoted prohibition; preserve but flag fallible ממנו1cp analysis. V18 ground as subject, thorns/thistles, field plants, imported לך2fs tag versus male discourse. V19 face sweat, bread/food, ground/dust and return. V20 Eve/living wordplay, narrative was/became/would-be, all living in human lineage context without a biology claim. No misogynistic prescriptions or invented ancient versions/lexicon quotes. Gen3:17 plain upstream accent comparison note is separate metadata, not scripture; unchanged exact word codepoints.
